# NexTeach 360™

## Information
NexTeach 360™ is a Unified Educational Operating System and AI Classroom Operating Environment powered by NextBoard™.

## Core Features
- **AI Lesson Architect:** One-click, curriculum-aligned teaching modules powered by Gemini. Builds an entire class framework in 60 seconds or less.
- **NextShield Security:** True Edge processing; scrubs PII locally on device CPU/GPU. Safe for FERPA, COPPA, and GDPR compliance.
- **Enterprise API Gateway:** Secure Key Encapsulation (SKE) for OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic.
- **Ecosystem:** Includes Student Pulse HUD, Live Feedback Echo Sessions, NextGrade AI automatic grading, and manual text export to WhatsApp.

## Pricing & Integration
Offers 3 distinct structural tiers: Individual BYO-API, Individual Provided, and School/Institutional Plan. Built for easy Google Classroom Roster API sync.
